name: Othavadai Street & Beach Strip
description: The narrow lanes of Othavadai Street and Othavadai Cross Street are lined with guesthouses, traveler cafes, tattoo parlors, and stone-carving shops, all a short stroll from the beach. It's the most social, walkable, and tourist-oriented part of Mahabalipuram, where most short-term visitors and nomads base themselves.
pros: Walkable to the beach and most cafes
Easiest place to meet other travelers
Most guesthouse and food options concentrated here
cons: Can feel noisy and touristy, especially in peak season

name: Shore Temple Area
tagline: Waking up next to a 7th-century temple
description: The stretch immediately around the seafront Shore Temple offers a quieter, more scenic base with sea views and easy sunrise access to the monument before the tour buses arrive. It's slightly removed from the densest hawker activity of Othavadai Street while still being walkable to it.
pros: Sunrise views of the Shore Temple and Bay of Bengal
Quieter than the main backpacker strip
Still walkable to restaurants and shops
cons: Fewer budget guesthouse options directly on this stretch
Gets crowded with day-trippers by mid-morning

name: Town Center & Bus Stand
description: The area around the main bus stand and market feels like an ordinary Tamil town rather than a tourist zone, with local eateries, provision shops, and the government-run Mamalla Bhavan. It's the practical hub for onward transport to Chennai and Pondicherry and a good gauge of local prices away from the beach markup.
bestFor: budget stays, transport connections, everyday errands
pros: Cheapest food and shopping in town
Direct bus connections to Chennai and beyond
cons: Further from the beach, requires a short auto or walk
Fewer traveler amenities like wifi cafes

name: Five Rathas & Southern Monuments
tagline: Quiet lanes among the monolithic temples
description: South of the main strip, the area near the Five Rathas and the stone-carving workshops is greener and more residential, with fewer hawkers and a slower pace. It borders the sculptors' quarter where artisans still carve granite using traditions passed down for generations, and sits within easy reach of quieter southern beaches toward Kovalam.
bestFor: longer stays, art and craft interest, quiet mornings
pros: Noticeably quieter and greener than the center
Easy access to less crowded southern beaches
cons: Limited restaurant and nightlife options nearby
Requires an auto or scooter for most errands
